description: Layer 5 of the track: evals, traces, regression suites and online metrics. It turns every other layer's decisions into measured evidence.
A test suite for non-deterministic code: a dataset, scorers that check properties of each output, and a report.
Seeing what a request did after the fact: traces with spans per model and tool call, tokens, cost, errors and timings.
Offline runs curated datasets before release; online scores live traffic after release with proxies, judges and feedback.
Shipping because a few tries looked good. The bad practice this module replaces with numbers and reasons.
The module's checkpoint: a decision record and an eval plan (critical cases, scorers, judge, gate, tracing, review sampling, drift alerts) for a briefing.
